prompt: Chunky cartoon 3D game prop in the same style as the reference grasshopper and termite mound: smooth rounded simple shapes, flat colour with two or three soft shading bands, a thick dark brown ink outline, one small glossy highlight, readable at a glance. Single object, centred, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain white background, even lighting, no text, no ground shadow.
